title: SDLC Task Decision v1
description: The task-specific payload for resolving one bounded design, compatibility, policy, or naming decision. It has exactly two root properties: intent defines the question and alternatives to evaluate, and result records the selected outcome and its consequences, posture, and affected references.
$comment: Decision completion and review are separate. A selected outcome may be recorded while a review is pending or changes are requested. Impact and confidence are integer scores from 0 through 100. The sdlc host may additionally verify that references resolve and that review and gate state follow the applicable policy.
